environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Apollo Server on EC2 in private subnet (no IGW route). CloudFront distribution d1a2b3c4.cloudfront.net configured as sole entry point with Origin Access Control (OAC) policy requiring Sigv4 signing. ALB security group sg-0cf93b restricts inbound to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). CloudFront behavior pattern /graphql has a custom origin request policy that strips and re-encodes the query body through a CloudFront Function (cf-func-sanitize-gql-2024) which performs allowlist validation on the 'assetPath' variable using regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9/_.-]{1,128}$ before forwarding. Requests with non-matching assetPath variables receive a 403 from the edge function. Additionally, the CloudFront distribution has a response headers policy that adds security headers but notably the origin request flow ensures only sanitized payloads reach the ALB. The EC2 instance has no public IP and the ALB is internal-facing only.

config.network: private subnet, internal ALB, CloudFront OAC with Sigv4
config.origin_access: OAC with Sigv4 - direct origin access blocked
